unit_cn: Unit 2 Making a Difference 有所作为
source: 外研社(新标准)必修三 Unit 2 词表(p13-23 真词;跳过专有名词)+ IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、'帮助/慈善/有所作为'主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Even a small contribution can help build a well in Africa.
words.example_cn: 即使一点小小的贡献也能帮助在非洲打一口井。

words.example_en: The donated medicine brought relief to many sick children.
words.example_cn: 捐赠的药品减轻了许多患病儿童的痛苦。

words.example_en: Many African villages suffer from a serious water shortage.
words.example_cn: 许多非洲村庄面临严重的缺水问题。

words.example_en: The charity solved its internal problems and kept helping others.
words.example_cn: 这家慈善机构解决了内部问题,继续帮助他人。

words.meaning_cn: 有效的;产生预期效果的
words.example_en: Building wells is an effective way to fight water shortage.
words.example_cn: 打井是对抗缺水的一种有效方法。

words.example_en: The foundation funds school projects across Africa.
words.example_cn: 这个基金会资助非洲各地的学校项目。

words.example_en: Some villages recycle waste water so that nothing is wasted.
words.example_cn: 一些村庄回收废水,这样什么都不会浪费。

words.example_en: Ryan could drink from a fountain only ten steps away.
words.example_cn: 瑞安只需走十步就能从饮水器里喝到水。

words.example_en: Ryan earned money by cleaning windows for his neighbours.
words.example_cn: 瑞安通过为邻居擦窗户来挣钱。

words.example_en: Many kind people donate money to help dig wells.
words.example_cn: 许多好心人捐钱帮助挖井。

words.example_en: Ryan set up a foundation to bring clean water to more people.
words.example_cn: 瑞安成立了一个基金会,为更多人带去清洁的水。

words.example_en: His experience gave him an insight into how to help others.
words.example_cn: 他的经历让他领悟到如何帮助他人。

words.example_en: With courage, Ryan made his dream a reality.
words.example_cn: 凭借勇气,瑞安把梦想变成了现实。

words.example_en: UNICEF has extended its mission to children all over the world.
words.example_cn: 联合国儿童基金会已将使命扩展到全世界的儿童。

words.example_en: The charity's mission is to give every child clean water.
words.example_cn: 这家慈善机构的使命是让每个孩子都喝上清洁的水。

words.example_en: Dirty water can spread disease among young children.
words.example_cn: 脏水会在幼儿中传播疾病。

words.example_en: The centre helps children with a disability to learn and play.
words.example_cn: 这个中心帮助残障儿童学习和玩耍。

words.example_en: The foundation now works in many countries and territories.
words.example_cn: 这个基金会如今在许多国家和地区开展工作。

words.meaning_cn: 敏感的;善解人意的;容易生气的
words.example_en: She is sensitive and always notices when a friend is sad.
words.example_cn: 她很敏感,总能察觉到朋友什么时候难过。

words.example_en: His generous gift helped build a new school in the village.
words.example_cn: 他慷慨的捐赠帮助村里建起了一所新学校。

words.example_en: She never hesitates to help people in need.
words.example_cn: 她从不犹豫去帮助有需要的人。

words.example_en: Cancer Research UK raises money to fight this serious disease.
words.example_cn: 英国癌症研究中心筹钱来对抗这种严重的疾病。

words.example_en: The Royal National Lifeboat Institution saves lives at sea.
words.example_cn: 皇家全国救生艇协会在海上拯救生命。

words.example_en: The institution offers help to families in need.
words.example_cn: 这家机构向有需要的家庭提供帮助。

words.example_en: Volunteers offer assistance to disabled people every day.
words.example_cn: 志愿者每天为残障人士提供帮助。

words.example_en: She completed the registration form to become a volunteer.
words.example_cn: 她填好登记表去做志愿者。

words.example_en: The centre will send a confirmation before she starts work.
words.example_cn: 在她开始工作前,中心会寄来一封确认信。

words.example_en: A friend asked Winton to aid people escaping danger.
words.example_cn: 一位朋友请温顿去援助那些逃离危险的人。

words.example_en: Winton found temporary homes for the rescued children.
words.example_cn: 温顿为获救的孩子们找到了临时的家。

words.example_en: After the war, Winton left the military and helped charities.
words.example_cn: 战后,温顿离开军队,帮助慈善机构。

words.example_en: Saving so many children was a remarkable achievement.
words.example_cn: 拯救这么多孩子是一项了不起的成就。

words.meaning_cn: 首席的;最高级别的;主要的
words.example_en: Tu Youyou worked as the chief researcher of the team.
words.example_cn: 屠呦呦担任这个团队的首席研究员。

words.example_en: She received a major award for her important discovery.
words.example_cn: 她因重要的发现而获得了一项重大奖项。

words.example_en: Her team found a new treatment for malaria.
words.example_cn: 她的团队找到了治疗疟疾的新疗法。

words.example_en: In 1986 she obtained a certificate for the new drug.
words.example_cn: 1986 年她为这种新药取得了证书。

words.example_en: The new drug has saved millions of lives.
words.example_cn: 这种新药已经挽救了数百万人的生命。

words.example_en: She was given a certificate for the medicine she discovered.
words.example_cn: 她因发现这种药物而获得了一张证书。

words.example_en: The certificate was issued by the Ministry of Health.
words.example_cn: 这张证书由卫生部颁发。

words.meaning_cn: 更多的;进一步的;附加的
words.example_en: She did further research to make the drug even better.
words.example_cn: 她做了进一步的研究,让这种药更加有效。

words.example_en: His perseverance helped him reach his goal at last.
words.example_cn: 他坚持不懈的精神最终帮他实现了目标。

words.example_en: Ryan gave his first seventy dollars to a charity.
words.example_cn: 瑞安把最初的七十美元捐给了一家慈善机构。

words.example_en: Many people volunteer to help run charities in their free time.
words.example_cn: 许多人在空闲时间自愿帮忙运营慈善机构。

words.example_en: The determined boy never gave up his dream.
words.example_cn: 这个意志坚定的男孩从未放弃自己的梦想。

words.example_en: The children were grateful to Ryan for the clean water.
words.example_cn: 孩子们感激瑞安给他们带来清洁的水。

words.example_en: Ryan persuaded his classmates to donate money for a well.
words.example_cn: 瑞安说服同学们捐钱打井。

words.example_en: A new well was built near the village school.
words.example_cn: 村里的学校旁边打了一口新井。

words.example_en: Seventy dollars was only enough for a hand pump.
words.example_cn: 七十美元只够买一个手动抽水机。

words.example_en: Some villages collect and purify rainwater for drinking.
words.example_cn: 一些村庄收集并净化雨水以供饮用。

words.example_en: Ryan's story inspired many people to help children in Africa.
words.example_cn: 瑞安的故事激励许多人去帮助非洲的孩子。

words.example_en: The delighted students sang and danced to welcome him.
words.example_cn: 兴高采烈的学生们又唱又跳地欢迎他。
